module: Orbitrol-type hydraulic steering regulator (type "auxiliary"). A PID compares the average position of the steering cylinders (normalized -1..1) to the steering input (electrics.values.steering_input by default) and writes the valve command into electrics.values.
notes: jbeam keys (default): steeringPositionCylinders (list of cylinder names), inputElectricsName ("steering_input"), steeringValveElectricsName ("steerCylinder"), steeringPositionMin (0), steeringPositionMax (1), steeringPIDKp (0.5), steeringPIDKi (0.3), steeringPIDKd (0.01).
Each cylinder's position is multiplied by cylinder.direction before averaging.

init.desc: Creates the PID and finds the cylinders.

reset.desc: Resets the valve and the PID to zero.

updateFixedStep.desc: Computes and writes the steering valve command.
